newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK-SHARES DIP IN HEAVY VOLUMES.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK-SHARES DIP IN HEAVY VOLUMES.

text.p: heavy trade as the NSE Overall Index dipped to 244.05 on Friday
A total value of N$21.6 million worth of shares was traded
in volume of 3.46 million stocks. The NSE Local Index ended at
156.28, down from 160.87 at the end of the previous week.
Dealing hit a peak on Wednesday with 31 complete deals in
one day. Much of the volume was made up of special deals in CIC
Holding , where 2.5 million shares traded at $N2.70
Namibia Breweries hit a record high price of
$N2.94 before consolidating to end the week at $N2.75.
Pep Namibia traded as high as $N4.35 after starting
the week at $N4.00 and Namibian Minerals Corp traded at
$N22.00 after several weeks of absence compared to a previous
